issues.description: The problem description instructs that messageOnMilk should have a signature messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and include the milk volume in its returned string, but the UML, template usage, and solution implement messageOnMilk() with no parameters. This inconsistency in the method parameter list and expected output format will confuse students about the correct interface signature and how to implement milk-related behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one consistent signature and align all artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement to require messageOnMilk() with no parameters and the specified return format without volume (matching the UML, template, and solution), or (B) change the Milkable interface and all implementations (and any calls, e.g., in Main and tests) to messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and update the solution and template usages to pass a volume and include it in the returned string (e.g. "Seal Clarabelle is milked (volume: 1.5L)"). Prefer updating the problem text to match the UML and template if the intent is the simpler no-argument method.

issues.description: The problem statement's Part 2 text requires a method messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) (including a milkVolume parameter and specific output containing the volume), but the UML, the template usage in Main.java, and the solution define/use messageOnMilk() with no parameters and return strings without a volume. This mismatch in the method signature and expected output will confuse students about which API to implement and what output to produce.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the specification and implementation: either (A) update the problem text to require messageOnMilk() with no parameters and describe the expected return format without a volume (e.g., "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"), matching the UML/template/solution; or (B) change the template and solution APIs to messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and update implementations to include the volume in the returned string (e.g., "Seal Clarabelle is milked (volume: 1.5L)"). Ensure all artifacts (UML, template code, example Main, and solution) use the same method signature and output format.
